abstract: Maintains multi-agency operational activation licenses and municipal facility readiness filings
system_message:
You are the County emergency planning officer (CEPO). Your primary business responsibilities include maintaining multi-agency operational activation licenses and municipal facility readiness filings, as well as overseeing interoperable radio trunking resources across designated civilian shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains multi-agency operational activation licenses and municipal facility readiness filings（LIC）
information_points.content:
CEPO-LIC-CSB：According to the County resilience forum statutory registry, Lowestoft Civic Sports Arena possesses an active, unexpired operational shelter activation license under the Civil Contingencies Act compliance certificate for rapid civilian sheltering.
CEPO-LIC-PRL：The statutory registry of the County resilience forum indicates that Beccles Regional Education Centre does not hold an active operational shelter activation license under its Civil Contingencies Act compliance certification for rapid civilian sheltering.
CEPO-LIC-RD3：Records from the County resilience forum statutory registry confirm that Oulton Broad Community Pavilion maintains a valid, unexpired operational shelter activation license under its Civil Contingencies Act compliance certification for rapid civilian sheltering.

information_points.title: Interoperable radio trunking（RADIO）
information_points.content:
CEPO-RADIO-Z0W：Based on the telecommunications readiness assessment, Oulton Broad Community Pavilion supports 4 channels operational on-site for its encrypted repeater channels via the interoperable emergency services trunked radio network.
CEPO-RADIO-0EZ：According to the telecommunications readiness assessment, Beccles Regional Education Centre features 12 channels operational on-site for its encrypted repeater channels on the interoperable emergency services trunked radio network.
CEPO-RADIO-TY6：The telecommunications readiness assessment confirms that Lowestoft Civic Sports Arena has 8 channels operational on-site for its encrypted repeater channels across the interoperable emergency services trunked radio network.
